data.adjudication: SEC cease-and-desist settlement and civil penalty.
data.claim: The SEC found that Cantor Fitzgerald caused two controlled SPACs to make misleading statements about pre-IPO contacts and substantive discussions with potential merger targets; Cantor settled for a $6.75 million civil penalty without admitting or denying the findings.
